cases.name: Suzanne Marie Collins
cases.about: She was a Lance Cpl. in the U.S. Marine Corp.
cases.narrative:
On 7/12/1985, her nude body was discovered by sheriff's deputies. Her head	was covered with blood, and she had large	bruises on each shoulder blade and scratches running from her shoulders	down to her waist.	A tree limb was inserted between her legs, with approximately eight	inches extending from her vaginal opening. Her left	eye was bruised and swollen shut, and	contusions and bite marks were observed to her breasts.

He had abducted her while she was jogging on the Naval Support Activity Mid-South U.S. Navy base in Millington, TN. She was taken to nearby Edmund Orgill Park. There, he severely beat Collins, fracturing her skull, before repeatedly shoving a tree limb up her vagina with enough force to penetrate her abdomen and tear one of her lungs. An autopsy showed her skull had been fractured with a screwdriver, and a 31-inch tree limb had been rammed into her vagina so hard that it entered her abdomen and lacerated one of her lungs.

The medical examiner said death was due to multiple injuries inflicted by blunt trauma to the head, pressing on the neck, and pushing 20.5 inches of a 31-inch long, 1.5 inch diameter sharply beveled tree limb up the perineum through the abdomen into the right chest, tearing abdominal and chest organs and producing internal hemorrhaging.
